title: RegisterSession then SendUnitData with connected-style SetAttributeSingle transport
purpose: Add connected explicit-message transport coverage distinct from SendRRData by using the documented Connected Address Item plus Connected Data Item CPF shape with a compact CIP service payload.

messages.label: SendUnitData with Connected Address Item and Connected Data Item carrying CIP SetAttributeSingle

expected_behavior: The peer should parse the SendUnitData encapsulation and CPF item structure. The connected transport or embedded service may be rejected with ordinary protocol or CIP status if no matching connection context exists, but the frame remains structurally valid for parser coverage.
constraints_preserved: SendUnitData command 0x0070 is used as documented
Encapsulated payload length is 30 bytes and matches the actual body
Item 1 is Connected Address Item type 0x0100 with 4-byte connection identifier
Item 2 is Connected Data Item type 0x00B1 with 14-byte payload
Connected Data payload begins with a 2-byte sequence count followed by a compact CIP request
Embedded CIP uses service 0x10 SetAttributeSingle with path_size 3 words and one byte of attribute data
Session handle is a placeholder for substitution after successful RegisterSession
issue_safety_notes: Safe connected-path coverage only. No attempt is made to forge connection state, inflate lengths, or reproduce any historical malformed payload; ordinary invalid-connection responses are acceptable.
